messages:
Nora: rough idea I sketched this morning: add a "summary strip" directly under the p95 heatmap. one-line per route: label, tiny sparkline, p50/p95 delta. clickable to expand into the full chart. goal = surface fast comparisons when triaging.

Imran: sounds useful. question: will the strip be live-updating? if so we need to be careful with reflows and CPU on low-end devices. maybe throttle updates to 5s.

Nora: yes live but throttled. I was thinking: liveThrottle = 5s; interactive scrub still shows detailed data.

Jules: accessibility flags: each strip row needs an accessible name and role=button if clickable. announce on focus: "Summary row for route /v1/chat — p95 340ms, up 4%". For color use patterned fill + colorblind-safe hues.

Aisha: copy nit: avoid jargon in the strip. replace "p95" with tooltip "p95 (95th percentile)" on hover for new users. small label: "p95: 340ms".

Imran: on sampling — our heatmap currently switches to reservoir sampling at high QPS. The summary strip should show whether the values are exact or sampled. propose a tiny pill: "sampled" / "exact". clicking it opens a quick explainer.

Nora: good call. mock: right-align a 24px pill that says "sampled" with an info icon. tooltip text: "Sampled values preserve trends but may not reflect exact percentiles. Switch to Exact to recompute (cost applies)."

Jules: keyboard interaction: Tab focuses row, Enter expands. When expanded, focus moves into the chart panel and Escape collapses. Also ensure focus-visible CSS is obvious in our dark theme.

Imran: backend requirements: we can return a compact payload per route: [route_id, display_name, p50, p95, p99, delta_pct, sparkline_buckets, sampling_mode]. keep payload tiny. e.g. CSV-like line per route to speed transfer.

Aisha: UI copy suggestion for pill: use "Sampling: Auto" and in the explainer mention cost tradeoff: "Exact: full computation, may increase query cost". Short and user-friendly.

Nora: visual affordance: collapsed sparklines should be 40px wide, 12px tall. on hover show a micro tooltip with absolute values for the hovered bucket. also show a caret up/down with color-coded delta.

Jules: aria-live behavior: only announce major changes (>10% delta) to avoid screen reader spam. Debounce announcements to 12s.

Imran: implementation thought: store last-sent snapshot hash and skip push if identical; use a sketch_seed for deterministic sampling to ensure consistent UX across refreshes.

Aisha: copy alternatives for the sampling explainer: ["Representative — stratified sampling to preserve overall trend" , "Exact — computes percentiles across all traces (higher cost)"] I'll put both in the doc for PM.

Nora: action items: Nora will update Figma with compact/expanded states + keyboard focus outlines; Imran to spec the compact API and sampling flag; Jules to run a contrast audit and screen reader test plan; Aisha to lock microcopy for pill and tooltips. I'll upload frames by tomorrow morning.

ui-bot: Created ticket #4272: "summary strip under p95 heatmap — mock + compact API + accessibility checks" assigned to Nora, Imran, Jules, Aisha. Due: 2026-03-29.

Imran: quick vote — start per-route only, no cross-route aggregation in v1. agree?

All: +1

Nora: ok thanks team, will iterate after initial feedback from SRE on perf. :sparkles:
